home: A poorly maintained house in Nebruz; will not leave after dark
appearance: Human male; missing both legs from the knee down, moves on short crutches. Eyes that expect the worst.
wants: Scraps; to survive the night; for the footsteps outside his door to stop
does_not_want: To be outside after dark; to speak of what was done to him
tragedies: Captured by a renegade band of lizard-folk (exiles from the treaty tribes) who tortured him and ate his legs over several days. Leeandra drove them off and returned him to Nebruz. His body survived; his mind did not.
Believes his severed legs return each night to walk outside his door and collect the rest of him.
pc_leverage: The renegade lizard-folk band is still at large in the swamp — distinct from the treaty tribes. Kalo is the only known survivor who has seen them. Getting him to speak requires extraordinary trust or extreme circumstances.
